details: Bitcoin experienced a significant drop, falling below $68,000 and marking its lowest price point since August 19. The cryptocurrency has plunged nearly 10% this week. This downturn is attributed to a strengthening US dollar, rising expectations for Federal Reserve interest rate hikes, and a general risk-off sentiment across global financial markets. Ethereum (ETH) and other major altcoins have also seen substantial declines, with ETH trading below $2,000.
title: Bitcoin Plummets Below $68K Amid Broad Market Sell-off

details: The sharp decline in cryptocurrency prices triggered a wave of liquidations across the market. Over $650 million in leveraged long positions were wiped out within a 13-hour period, with Bitcoin liquidations alone accounting for a significant portion. These large-scale liquidations exacerbated the downward price pressure on digital assets.
title: Over $650M in Crypto Long Positions Liquidated in Market Downturn

details: The highly anticipated Initial Public Offering (IPO) of artificial intelligence firm Anthropic, expected to launch next week, is being considered a potential factor in the current cryptocurrency market slump. Analysts suggest that investors might be reallocating capital from risk assets, including cryptocurrencies, to position themselves for the potentially lucrative tech offering.
title: Anthropic IPO Emerges as Potential Headwind for Crypto Capital
